page: Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features a dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor. This CPU configuration provides 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache, alongside advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

The server is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 32.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. For local storage, the instance includes 7559 GB of local disk capacity and is premium storage capable, though it does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware. This massive memory-to-CPU ratio makes the hardware profile highly specialized for memory-intensive workloads.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in memory bandwidth and data processing. The server achieved a strong rating in uncached large-block memory bandwidth, with read speeds of 238.84 GB/sec and write speeds of 137.13 GB/sec. Single-threaded gzip compression reached 31.18 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput was measured at 44.43 GB/sec, both scoring in the top 25% tier. Other metrics, including a passmark CPU score of 47316.29, a redis SET operations rate of 43.41 million operations per second, and a multi-core stress-ng CPU performance of 31881.31, fall within the average tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E128-32ds_v6 offers high memory and local storage density relative to its 32 vCPU compute allocation, making it a resource-dense option for workloads that do not require massive parallel CPU scaling but demand large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring substantial local scratch space.
